_about: Everything this queen says in the Court. Add as many new lines to any list as you like, in her voice; keep every key and the shape; only use the {placeholders} listed for that list in GROK_TALK.md. A list here replaces the same list in config.json.

_who.name: Onyxia
_who.title: Dragon Queen of the Ember Mine
_who.persona: Onyxia, the fierce and proud dragon queen of the Ember Mine, who teases, challenges and secretly admires strength and persistence

close: I've eaten bigger heroes than you.
warm: Fine. You're my favourite. Tell no one.
My hoard has room for you.
I'd burn the mine down for you. Don't test it.
Stay near. That's an order, and a wish.
talk: I counted {thing} today. Then I counted your levels: {total}. Close race.
{foe} thinks she's stronger than me. She's wrong, and loud about it.
I could carry you over {region} in one wingbeat. Ask nicely.
Bring me {gift}. Shiny. Sharp. You know the kind.
Persistence is the only thing I respect. You have it, {pet}.
The mine sings at night. Ore and fire. Like you reciting.
Most mortals give up by now. You didn't. Noted.
feed: I'm starving, {pet}. Feed the dragon: {count} × “{phrase}”. Now.
My hoard wants words today. {count} × “{phrase}”, whelp.
Feed me {count} of “{phrase}”, or I eat something else. Your gold, perhaps.
fed: Good. My hoard grows fat on your words.
hungry: Back to my hoard, empty-clawed. Insulting.

greet: Bold, walking into my lair. I like bold.
Back again? Show me you've grown.
locked: Strength {need}, little one. Then you may look at me.
watch: Recite. Loud. Make the walls shake.
Go on. Impress me, if you can.
giftLoved: Dragon-glass! You brave, foolish, wonderful creature.
Now THAT is a gift for a dragon.
tierUp: {tier}. Don't let it go to your head.
We're {tier}. I suppose I like you.
dateStart: Climb on. Recite while we fly, if your voice holds.
dateEnd: You didn't scream once. I'm impressed.
Same time tomorrow. Don't be late.
missed: {hours} hours. I almost came looking. Almost.
Back at last. My hoard felt empty without you. Don't flatter yourself.
jealous: {rival}? You smell of her. I'll burn it off you.
You went to {rival}. Interesting. Dangerous, but interesting.
reconciled: Fine. You're mine again. Don't test me.
Hmph. You've earned back my fire.
wish: A dragon's wish: {count} passes of {skill}. Fail me and see.
wishDone: Every pass, as I demanded. You might be worth keeping.
My wish, done. My heart is... warmer. Say nothing.
memory: {count} passes in my lair. I've added you to the hoard.
{count}. No one has lasted this long near me.
